text.p: Police on Thursday disarmed a 17-year-old youth who took two people hostage in the Siberian city of Omsk and asked for $500,000 and a flight out of Russia.
Interfax news agency, quoting Interior Ministry officials, said two police officers overpowered the hostage-taker on the way to Omsk airport.
The masked youth, who earlier asked for food and a bottle of vodka, had swapped his two civilian hostages for three policemen, Itar-Tass news agency said.
It said the man had threatened to blow up the theatre where he seized his hostages and kill them unless his demands were met. But nobody was hurt.

"They told me by radio that the criminal had been captured and was in handcuffs," Tass quoted regional interior ministry official Yevgey Starozhenko as saying. "He looked quite ordinary with his black mask off."
